brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Build contains two separate pairs of bases (four bases total, arranged as two pairs)
requirements.evidence: 4 pieces placed: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,1,0;full. Arranged as bottom pair (0,0 + 1,0) and top pair (0,1 + 1,1). check_build meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: The two pairs are joined to each other only with side connectors (no other inter-pair hardware)
requirements.evidence: 3 side-connectors: connector:0#0,0|1,0 (joins bottom pair), connector:0#0,1|1,1 (joins top pair), connector:0#0,0|0,1 (joins the pairs together). No joint bolts or other connectors. check_build shows no LOOSE_BODY warning and no extra hardware.

finish.summary: Four bases in 2x2 cluster forming two logical pairs (0,0-1,0 and 0,1-1,1) with one side-connector per pair plus a third side-connector linking the pairs (0,0-0,1). All inter-base joins are side-connectors only, verified by check_build clear. No joint bolts present.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

result.note: A side connector joins two bases that stand side by side on the same storey. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
